tour.name: Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar 10-Day Private Tour: Tarangire, the Serengeti, Ngorongoro & the Spice Island
tour.subtitle: Ten days from the savannah to the Indian Ocean with private guides: elephants in Tarangire, two full days in the Serengeti with the Great Migration, the Ngorongoro Crater, a flight to Zanzibar, Stone Town and spices, and beach days on the white sands of the east coast.

tour.overview:
Tanzania offers one of the world's great combinations: a safari in the north, among the wildlife of the Serengeti and Ngorongoro, followed by the white beaches and Swahili culture of Zanzibar. This private tour takes you from the parks of the northern circuit, with a private driver-guide and 4x4, to the Spice Island by plane.

You stay in safari lodges or tented camps with full board during the safari, and in a beach hotel on Zanzibar, with time to relax at the end.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 10 days, 9 nights
• Start: Kilimanjaro airport
• End: Zanzibar airport
• Type: private safari with driver-guide and 4x4; domestic flight; 9 nights (full board on safari, breakfast on Zanzibar)
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, lodges, flight and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Tarangire.
• The Serengeti.
• The Ngorongoro Crater.
• Stone Town and a spice farm.
• Zanzibar’s beaches.

WHY THIS WORKS
The private safari sets its own pace and follows the migration, and the flight to Zanzibar avoids a long journey back to the coast.

WHO IT SUITS
Honeymooners, families and first-time visitors to Africa.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
Add a Kilimanjaro climb before, or Mnemba snorkelling on Zanzibar.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Check vaccination and visa requirements for Tanzania. Domestic flights have a soft-bag limit of about 15 to 20 kilograms.

private: Private 4x4 safari vehicle with pop-up roof

days.name: Arrival at Kilimanjaro and Arusha
days.description:
What to expect: a private welcome.

Your driver meets you at Kilimanjaro airport and takes you to your lodge near Arusha, among coffee plantations, with views of Mount Meru.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Any time – Airport transfer.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Your guide briefs you in the evening.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: lodge near Arusha.
Meals: none.

days.name: Tarangire National Park
days.description:
What to expect: elephants and baobabs.

A full day of game drives in Tarangire, among elephant herds and giant baobabs, with a picnic lunch by the river.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
07:30 – Departure.
09:30 – Game drives.
17:00 – Lodge.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Wear neutral colours.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, fees, meals.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks.

Overnight: lodge near Tarangire.
Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner.

days.name: To the Serengeti via Olduvai Gorge
days.description:
What to expect: the endless plains.

Through the Ngorongoro Highlands to Olduvai Gorge and into the Serengeti, with a game drive on the way to your camp.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
07:30 – Departure.
12:30 – Olduvai Gorge.
14:30 – Serengeti game drive.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A long but spectacular day.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, fees, meals.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks.

Overnight: camp in the Serengeti.
Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner.

days.name: The Serengeti
days.description:
What to expect: a full day of game drives.

A full day in the Serengeti, following the big cats and, depending on the season, the herds of the Great Migration.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
06:30 – Morning game drive.
13:00 – Picnic.
15:00 – Afternoon game drive.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A balloon flight can be added.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, fees, meals.
NOT INCLUDED: balloon.

Overnight: camp in the Serengeti.
Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner.

days.name: The Serengeti
days.description:
What to expect: a second day on the plains.

Another full day in a different area of the Serengeti, chosen by your guide for the best wildlife of the season.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
06:30 – Game drives all day.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Sundowners can be arranged.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, fees, meals.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks.

Overnight: camp in the Serengeti.
Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner.

days.name: To the Ngorongoro crater rim
days.description:
What to expect: a last Serengeti morning and the highlands.

A morning game drive, then the drive back to the Ngorongoro highlands for a night on the crater rim.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
06:30 – Game drive.
10:00 – Drive to Ngorongoro.
16:00 – Lodge.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The rim is cold at night.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, fees, meals.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks.

Overnight: lodge on the Ngorongoro rim.
Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner.

days.name: The Ngorongoro Crater and fly to Zanzibar
days.description:
What to expect: the crater and the Spice Island.

An early game drive on the crater floor, then the drive to Arusha airport (or Manyara airstrip) for the flight to Zanzibar, and a transfer to your beach hotel.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
06:30 – Crater floor.
12:00 – Drive to the airstrip.
Afternoon – Flight to Zanzibar.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Pack light for the flight.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, fees, flight, transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: beach hotel on Zanzibar.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: Stone Town and a spice farm
days.description:
What to expect: Zanzibar’s history and flavours.

A spice farm with lunch, the alleys and doors of Stone Town, the slave market memorial and Darajani market.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – Spice farm.
13:30 – Stone Town.
17:00 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Dress modestly in Stone Town.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, entrances, lunch.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: beach hotel on Zanzibar.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: A free day on the beach
days.description:
What to expect: time to relax.

A free day on the beach. Snorkelling at Mnemba, Jozani Forest or a sunset dhow cruise can be added.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
All day – Free.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Tides change the beaches dramatically on the east coast.

INCLUDED: —
NOT INCLUDED: activities, meals.

Overnight: beach hotel on Zanzibar.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Departure from Zanzibar
days.description:
What to expect: a private transfer.

After breakfast, your driver takes you to Zanzibar airport for your onward flight.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
As needed – Airport transfer.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Allow 3 hours for international flights.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: none.
Meals: breakfast.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Where is the Great Migration?
faq.answer: It moves with the rains; we place your Serengeti camps where the herds are expected.

faq.question: What kind of accommodation is used?
faq.answer: Mid-range lodges or tented camps on safari and a beach hotel on Zanzibar; luxury upgrades are available.

faq.question: Is the flight to Zanzibar included?
faq.answer: Yes, with a soft-bag limit of about 15 to 20 kilograms.

faq.question: Are meals included?
faq.answer: Full board on safari and breakfast on Zanzibar, plus lunch on the spice tour.

faq.question: Is it suitable for a honeymoon?
faq.answer: Perfectly; tell us and we will add special touches.

faq.question: Can we climb Kilimanjaro too?
faq.answer: Yes, before the safari, on a 6- to 8-day climb.

faq.question: Do we need vaccinations or a visa?
faq.answer: Check with your doctor and embassy; malaria prevention is recommended and a visa is required for most nationalities.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Neutral clothes for safari, warm layers for mornings, and beachwear for Zanzibar.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: June to October for safari; January to February for the calving season.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary on safari in Tanzania: guides, drivers and camp staff appreciate a tip if you were happy with their service, but it is always your choice. Your guide can suggest typical amounts.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour starts. Lodges and flights have stricter terms; we explain them when we confirm. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
